name: Annelies Dekker
bio:
Annelies Dekker's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After a successful career in statistical modeling for financial institutions, she found herself drawn to the high-stakes world of racing through a chance encounter with a local racing team. Intrigued by the potential of data to unlock performance gains, she made a career pivot, bringing her analytical rigor and attention to detail to the track. She joined MP Motorsport five years ago and has quickly become an indispensable part of the team's strategy.

Annelies approaches data analysis with a meticulous eye, believing that every data point tells a story. She's known for her ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets, helping the team optimize everything from tire management to aerodynamic configurations. Her dedication to accuracy and her relentless pursuit of improvement make her a valuable asset to the team. She distinguishes herself by her ability to clearly communicate technical findings to both engineers and drivers, fostering a collaborative environment where data informs every decision.

physical.description: Annelies is a slender woman with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Dutch coffee in the office.
